# Muhammad Bilal

> Muhammad Bilal is a software engineer with a design practice, based in Pakistan. He builds reliable product interfaces and designs the workflows behind them. His domain is travel and aviation software, and he currently works at Aeroglobe.

Muhammad Bilal is a software engineer with a design practice. He specializes in travel and aviation software and in UI/UX workflow design. He currently works at Aeroglobe.

## Work

- [BLANX](https://bilalmuhammad41.github.io/left-brain-right-pixels/llm/projects/blanx.md): Custom apparel shop with a generative art studio built in (2024)
- [LINKLATER](https://bilalmuhammad41.github.io/left-brain-right-pixels/llm/projects/linklater.md): A one-page way to ask a friend out, built around Richard Linklater (2024)
- [SMARTCHOICE](https://bilalmuhammad41.github.io/left-brain-right-pixels/llm/projects/smartchoice.md): Insurance comparison for car, bike, health, and travel cover in Pakistan (2024)
- [SEEDINOV](https://bilalmuhammad41.github.io/left-brain-right-pixels/llm/projects/seedinov.md): Studio site for custom software, AI products, and shipped case studies (2024)

- [MY TODO](https://bilalmuhammad41.github.io/left-brain-right-pixels/llm/projects/my-todo.md): Minimal task manager built with vanilla JavaScript (2023)
